content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: The appointment entitles the appointee to a remuneration as per pay-scale Level – 10 of the Matrix (Pre-revised PB-3, entry pay of ₹ 56,100/- PM + usual allowance). Non-Practicing Allowance (NPA) is applicable for medical candidates only. Leave entitlement follows the Central Residency Scheme and Institute Policy. The appointment is for a period of 12 months on a contract basis under the Govt. of India's Residency Scheme and does not vest any right to claim permanent absorption or continued contractual appointment. Private practice of any kind is prohibited.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for AIIMS Jodhpur Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Visit the official AIIMS Jodhpur website at www.aiimsjodhpur.edu.in . Access the online registration of application link for Tutor / Demonstrator posts w.e.f. 12th October, 2026. Fill out the online application form for one department only and submit it by 2nd November, 2026 (17:00 Hrs.).

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Identity Proof (PAN Card, Passport, Driving License, Voter Card, Aadhar Card etc.) Address Proof Certificate showing Date of Birth (Birth Certificate / 10th Certificate) Class 10th & 12th Marksheet and Certificates Qualifying degree marksheets and degree certificates (MBBS/B.Sc./M.Sc.) Attempt and Internship Completion Certificate Registration with Medical Council of India / State Medical Council Experience Certificate (if applicable) FMGE certificate conducted by NBE (For foreign graduates) Reservation category Certificate (OBC / SC / ST / PH) belonging to non-creamy layer of Central List for OBC, issued within one year EWS certificate issued after 01.04.2026 and valid for financial year 2026-27 No Objection Certificate for candidates working in Government Institutions Publications

faq.question: Q1. Is this post permanent or on contract, and for how long?
faq.answer: The appointment is on a contract basis for a period of 12 months under the Govt. of India’s Residency Scheme and does not vest any right to claim permanent absorption.

faq.question: Q2. Are HRA or allowances paid on top of the pay?
faq.answer: Yes, appointees receive entry pay of ₹ 56,100/- PM at Level 10 plus usual allowances admissible under rules, with NPA applicable for medical candidates only.

faq.question: Q3. Who gets a relaxation in age and how much?
faq.answer: The upper age limit of 30 years is relaxable by up to 5 years for SC/ST candidates, up to 3 years for OBC candidates, and for PwBD candidates up to 10 years for General, 13 years for OBC, and 15 years for SC/ST candidates.

faq.question: Q4. How are candidates shortlisted for selection?
faq.answer: Shortlisting is done in a 1:6 ratio, followed by a written examination or interview depending upon the number of applications received.

faq.question: Q5. Which documents must be brought or sent during the process?
faq.answer: Candidates must not send hard copies of the online application. However, at the time of interview, candidates must bring original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies, including identity proof, date of birth certificate, marksheets, degree certificates, internship certificate, council registration, category certificates, and NOC if applicable.
